title: President accuses PM Tusk of forced takeover of Poland's top court
detail: Poland's President accused Prime Minister Donald Tusk of carrying out a forced takeover of the country's top court. Only the headline-level summary was available at time of writing; details of the specific measures alleged and any government response were not retrieved.

title: Tusk: 'Poland has not perished and will not perish' amid Constitutional Tribunal crisis
detail: Prime Minister Donald Tusk declared that 'Poland has not perished and will not perish' as the country is gripped by a serious political crisis over the Constitutional Tribunal, per Le Monde. Only the headline-level summary was available; details of the specific measures were not retrieved.
